expects.reason: net8.0 is fully supported. The solution builds and its tests pass, so Coverlet instruments the test run and reports statement and branch coverage. It comes from NuGet; where NuGet is refused it exits 4 instead.

data.planted: a branch-dense target where statement and branch coverage genuinely differ
data.expected: a statement-coverage and a branch-coverage number that are not equal
data.note: The C# core of this folder's fixtures is C# 5-compatible, so it is identical on all 13 families and what the tool measures cannot drift between them. The LanguageMarker class in each file is what pins the file to C# 12.0; it does not compile under C# 11.0. No project manifest is present, by design.
